lines.text: Hi team, the offsite is confirmed for March 12 to 14 in Lisbon. We stay at a small hotel in Alfama, ten minutes on foot from the venue, and flights go on the company card as usual.

Three things I need from you by Friday: your arrival time, any dietary needs, and whether you want to join the boat trip on Thursday afternoon. If you can't come, tell me directly so I can release your room before the deadline on the 20th.
The agenda is attached. Day one is planning, day two is workshops, day three is free until the late flight. Bring a laptop, comfortable shoes and one idea you think we should stop doing.
Thanks! Lena
Done. I've moved token refresh out of the individual API clients and into TokenService, so there is now exactly one place that decides when a token is stale and how it gets renewed.
What changed
Fourteen call sites now ask TokenService.current() instead of refreshing on their own.
The retry-on-401 logic lives in one interceptor, with a single in-flight refresh shared by concurrent requests.
Logout clears the cache and revokes the refresh token server-side.
What still needs you

Two tests in the session suite fail, because they still mock the old AuthClient and never see the new service. I can either update the mock, which is about ten lines, or keep the old code path behind a flag for one release. Which do you prefer?
Mockups for the new onboarding are up. Can you do 10 tomorrow for the review? Otherwise Thursday after lunch.
Okay, let's start. The goal for today is to agree on a launch date for the new website.
Design is nearly done. I need two more days for the demo section, so Thursday at the earliest.
Thursday works if the copy is final by Wednesday. Can you own that?
Yes. I'll send the final copy on Wednesday at noon.
Then let's ship Thursday morning, before the newsletter goes out.
Lena needs three things from you by Friday: your arrival time, any dietary needs, and yes or no on Thursday's boat trip. Can't come? Tell her before the 20th so she can release your room.
Friday for your three answers. The hard one is the 20th: after that, your room can no longer be released.
A laptop, comfortable shoes, and one idea for something the team should stop doing.
I moved token refresh into one place and touched fourteen files. Two tests fail on the old mock. Should I update the mock, or keep the old path for now?
Two in the session suite: refresh on expiry, and logout clears tokens. Both still mock the old auth client, so they never see the new service. Updating the mock is about ten lines.
Not yet. The code is done, but with two red tests you can't tell whether logout really clears tokens. Fix the mock first; then it's a small, safe change.
No. Callers still ask for a token the same way. Only where the refresh happens moved: from fourteen places into TokenService.
Ben asks whether 10 tomorrow works for the onboarding review. If not, Thursday after lunch.
Just a time: yes to 10 tomorrow, or Thursday after lunch.
Launch moves to Thursday morning, before the newsletter. You owe the final copy on Wednesday at noon.
The final copy, by Wednesday at noon. Ben finishes the demo section; Anna wants it all live before the newsletter.
